subject: history
concept: Understanding ancient religious or spiritual beliefs at a basic, respectful, comparative level
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's complete-truth and multi-perspective principles — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines an illustrated ancient religious symbol or story and discusses what it may have meant to that culture
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described belief or practice to the civilization it belonged to
exercise.abstract: Student explains, respectfully and factually, one belief held by a studied ancient civilization

misconception_flags: presents an ancient belief system dismissively or inaccurately rather than factually and respectfully

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
